changelog: Partner application page: the confirmation box after a send offers **Send another application**, which clears the tab's "sent" flag (#3534) and opens an empty form — a second application (another address, a colleague) no longer needs a new tab. The anti-spam fill time restarts with the empty form (#3731).

en: Partner application: after sending, “Send another application” opens an empty form again.
tr: Partner başvurusu: gönderdikten sonra “Başka bir başvuru gönder” ile boş form yeniden açılıyor.
de: Partnerbewerbung: Nach dem Senden öffnet „Weitere Bewerbung senden“ wieder ein leeres Formular.
